C1791.title: Cybercriminals Exploit Remote Monitoring Tools to Infiltrate Logistics and Freight Networks
C1791.summary: The Hacker News reports that cybercriminals are leveraging remote monitoring and management tools to penetrate logistics and freight company networks, carrying out supply chain attacks. By abusing legitimate remote access software, attackers bypass security controls to gain entry into corporate systems, steal data, or deploy ransomware.
